name.description: Company name. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

countryCode.description: Country as two capital letters, for example SE. Leave it out or send null to clear it.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed.

roles.description: Role keys, for example Admin or Salesperson.

homeCountry.description: Home country as two capital letters, or null.

ExchangeRate.description: SEK per unit of a currency in one month. SEK itself has no rate: it is always 1.

currency.description: Currency code as three capital letters, for example USD.

month.description: First day of the month the rate applies to.

rateToSek.description: SEK per unit of the currency, as text with at most 6 decimals, for example 10.50. A JSON number is accepted when writing. Responses always show 6 decimals.

updatedAt.description: When the rate was last changed.

operations.summary: Create or update an account by external id
operations.description: Idempotent. Creates the account (201) when the external id is new, otherwise updates the account it maps to (200). Admin and Integration roles only. If-Match is ignored.

system.description: The system that owns the id.

operations.description: Soft delete: the account no longer appears in reads. Admin only.
Rates of all currencies and months, most recently changed first by default.

operations.summary: Set the exchange rate of a currency for a month
operations.description: Admin only. Creates the rate (201) or replaces the existing one (200).

currency.description: Currency code, for example USD. SEK has no rate.
